rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a character an opponent controls. You may pay 2. If you do, that character's controller picks another character they control. -- Put the characters on the bottom their owner's deck. Draw a card.
flavor: "...what came next consumed the Empire and changed the world forever." — Marduun, A Forgotten History
notes: Card prints 'on the bottom their owner's deck' (missing 'of'); catalog has 'on the bottom of their owner's deck' (printed typo, same meaning). Attribution printed with a hyphen on the same line as the quote.

name: Defiler of Innocence
subtitle: ugh, wizards
rules: CORRUPT -- COST – Pay 2. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains COVERT. -- DEFILE -- COST – Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Look at an opponent's hand and choose a character in it. That player discards that character.

name: Desolate
subtitle: i didn't know it was a verb either

name: Domain of Depravity
subtitle: where's waldo now?
rules: At the start of your turn, you may pick a character. If you do, put a token on it. -- All characters lose 1 strength, 1 life, and 1 speed for each token on them.
flavor: "These cutaneous lichens will be delicious in my soup!"

name: Encumber
subtitle: he should have brought crackers for everyone
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a character or location. -- Put the character or location into its owner's hand. -- RECUR – [O] -- COST – Use this only if this card is in your discard pile. Pay 2. Remove this card from the game. -- EFFECT – Look at an opponent's hand and choose a non-resource card in it. That opponent discards that card.

notes: Option 2 prints an 'EFFECT –' label before 'This turn, the character gains COVERT.'; catalog omits that label only (no change in play).

Put the remaining cards on the top of your deck in any order. -- SEDUCTIVE SUMMONS -- COST – Pay 1. Pick a tactic that was voided by this card. -- EFFECT – You may deploy that card.

Inflict 6 damage to all factions. All players remove 6 cards in their hand from the game. All players remove 6 cards in their discard pile from the game. All players remove the top 6 cards of their deck from the game.

notes: No subtitle line; the name wraps over two lines. Footer also prints 'original Open R&D concept by kallisti'.
